items.title: Matrix Multiplication is Θ(n^2.25) [pdf]
items.title_zh: 预印本声称矩阵乘法指数恰为 9/4
items.title_en: Preprint Claims Matrix Multiplication Exponent Is Exactly 9/4
items.summary: A preprint claims the matrix multiplication exponent is exactly 9/4 (and resolves several other open problems), reportedly produced by an unreleased OpenAI model, sparking debate on AI-driven mathematical discovery and lab incentives.

items.title: Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B
items.title_zh: PrismML 发布 Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B，主打本地智能体编程
items.title_en: PrismML Releases Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B for Local Agentic Coding
items.summary: Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B, a ternary-quantized local LLM, drew strong HN attention for running long-context agentic coding on a Mac Mini with surprisingly competitive benchmark results.

items.title: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities
items.title_zh: OpenAI 称 GPT-6.2 通过自己写代码完成蛋白质微结合器设计
items.title_en: OpenAI claims GPT-6.2 designed protein minibinders by writing its own code
items.summary: OpenAI reports that GPT-6.2 designed three-dimensional minibinder structures from target protein structures by writing its own code, while using specialized models (e.g., SolubleMPNN) for sequence generation and filtering — a claim HN commenters view as impressive orchestration/glue work rather than a clean replacement for domain-specific models.

items.title: Active intrusion campaign against Check Point security management servers
items.title_zh: GreyNoise：Check Point 管理服务器遭 PRNG 状态恢复攻击入侵
items.title_en: GreyNoise: Check Point management servers hit by PRNG state-recovery campaign
items.summary: GreyNoise documents an active intrusion campaign exploiting Check Point security management servers, including a notable PRNG state-recovery attack that forges admin session cookies.

items.title: GPT 6.2 Astra Solves a Historical Mystery
items.title_zh: GPT-6.2 Astra 自主破解 1808 年耶鲁速写本的作者之谜
items.title_en: GPT-6.2 Astra Autonomously Solves an 1808 Yale Sketchbook Mystery
items.summary: A history professor reports that GPT-6.2 Astra autonomously identified the creator of an anonymous 1808 Yale sketchbook in 22 minutes using public sources and uncovered a significant new archival source.

items.title: 🤖 Anthropic 称内部 Claude 模型发现 VP≠VNP 并公开 Lean 4 证明  Anthropic 于 11 月 24 日公开论文《VP ≠
items.title_zh: Anthropic 称 Claude 发现 VP≠VNP 并给出 Lean 4 形式化证明
items.title_en: Anthropic Claims Claude Found VP≠VNP Proof With Lean 4 Formalization
items.summary: Anthropic reportedly claims an internal Claude model discovered a proof of VP≠VNP over every field, published with a Lean 4 formalization, though the extraordinary result remains unverified.

items.title: vCenter 再曝 9.8 分免鉴权漏洞，几天前刚被零日利用
items.title_zh: VMware vCenter 再曝 9.8 分鉴权绕过漏洞，且已被零日利用
items.title_en: VMware vCenter hit by another 9.8 authentication bypass, exploited as zero-day
items.summary: Broadcom 修复了 VMware 产品线 23 个漏洞，其中 vCenter 目录服务存在 9.8 分鉴权绕过漏洞 CVE-2026-123903，并已在补丁发布前几天遭零日利用。
